name: io.github.iowarp/web-mcp
title: CLIO Web
description: Provider-fixed web search plus transparent URL, DOI, and document fetching

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch an HTTP(S) URL or DOI as a durable task. HTML and text are read locally; supported documents use CLIO Web Search conversion when configured.

tools.name: fetch_events
tools.description: Query the full ordered backend event log for a document fetch conversion.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web using this installation's fixed ddg provider.

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Return the active installation's search, fetch, and task capabilities.

prompts.name: research_web
prompts.description: Provide a guided search-then-fetch research workflow.
